messages:
jana-support: Hey — p95/p99 lines disappeared from the acme-prod latency dashboard right after the metrics-gateway cutover (~10m ago). Customer is paged, screenshot attached https://redwood.screens/xyz :/

omar-oncall: On it. Can you paste the panel query or a dashboard link?

jana-support: Dashboard https://console.redwood/acme/prod/dash/latency. Panel query uses metric `latency_ms` with label `quantile`. In tenant view I only see series for quantile=0.5 and 0.9, nothing for 0.95/0.99.

metrics-bot: deploy-bot: metrics-gateway v2.3.1 cutover completed at 2167890000 by @ci/deploy :rocket:

omar-oncall: Quick reproduction:
```
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/v1/series?match[]={__name__=\"latency_ms\"}" | jq '.data[] | select(.metric.quantile==\"0.99\")'
```
returns nothing.

liam-eng-sre: Hmm. Gateway change might be translating histograms -> summaries differently. Any chance `export_summaries` or `histogram_to_summary` got toggled for the canary?

omar-oncall: Checking gateway pod envs... found METRICS_EXPORT_SUMMARIES=false in the new config (looks like a leftover canary flag). That would strip summary/quantile series.

omar-oncall: Flipping METRICS_EXPORT_SUMMARIES=true on the canary and rolling it forward now (:wrench:).

sara-customer-success: ACME reports they still see blanks but will wait a minute.

omar-oncall: Rollout done, restarting gateway pods. Running same curl now — returns entries for quantile=0.95 and 0.99.

metrics-bot: metrics-gateway pods restarted by deploy-bot at 2167890605

sara-customer-success: Customer confirms p95/p99 are back in their tenant view — they can see the lines again :white_check_mark:

jana-support: Marking this as resolved for now. Creating follow-up ticket INC-1234 to track root cause & add a safer default.

liam-eng-sre: Suggest a follow-up PR to set METRICS_EXPORT_SUMMARIES=true by default and add an alert that detects missing quantile series for production tenants. I'll own the postmortem if the alert fires.

omar-oncall: Logged config rollback and PR link in INC-1234. Thanks everyone :eyes:

jana-support: Adding customer note and closing the support escalation.
